name: Reasoning Playability And Usability-Agent Test
generated_lesson_output_condition: Only through scripts/deploy.js if usability-agent evidence requires an allowed UI/CSS/copy repair.
scope: Run separate usability-agent tests against generated reasoning routes.
Record whether agents understand goal, controls, feedback, retry, and next action without hidden instructions.
Repair only allowed UI/CSS/copy blockers if agent evidence requires it.
Produce usability traces, analysis, screenshots, checker evidence, and lead-review artifacts.
acceptance_tests: npx.cmd jest --runInBand engines/tests/reasoning-engine.test.js engines/tests/reasoning-ui.test.js engines/tests/task-shell-engine.test.js engines/tests/task-shell-ui.test.js
npm.cmd run check:book -- "../4veco-lessen/Boek 1 - Grondslagen, vraag en aanbod"
forbidden: No hand edits to generated Book 1 output.
No candidate storage creation or writes.
No target-equivalent claims or completion language.
No mode 2 or mode 4 adoption claim.
No diagnostics, adaptive routing, mastery, sequencing, student-facing AI, summative use, PV, Scale Gate 1, or product-wide use.
stop_conditions: Usability agents cannot complete mode 0, 1, 3, or 5 because page or controls are broken.
Agent traces show task cannot be understood without hidden instructions and repair exceeds allowed paths.
Repair would require reasoning CSV edits, source exit-ticket data, protected references, target-exercise fields, or candidate storage.
Generated output is changed by hand instead of deploy.
Mode 2 or mode 4 is described as unified/adopted.
Any artifact claims target-equivalent proof, diagnostics, mastery, sequencing, Scale Gate 1, or product use.
Lead review returns REVISE and corrections are not applied before closure.
